retrievalProfile.description: A high-energy urban editorial layout featuring a low-angle subject and eclectic, multi-colored ransom-note style typography.
triggerTerms: low angle urban portrait with collage text

recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic magazine-style composition characterized by a low-angle perspective of a central figure against a city backdrop, topped with a large, colorful masthead made of individual paper-cut letters in varying fonts and colors.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's head overlaps the central masthead, creating depth.
The low-angle camera tilt aligns with the upward perspective of the surrounding buildings.
The vibrant, multi-colored text blocks contrast against the clear blue sky.
Black tape-like bars provide a grounding horizontal element for secondary text.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure, full body from waist up, dominating the lower two-thirds of the frame in a towering low-angle shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eclectic 'I TOLD THEM' masthead at the top of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the colorful masthead, moves down the subject's body, then circles through the secondary text blocks in the corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper sky area provides breathing room for the heavy masthead typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sky blue and denim blue provide the primary cool-toned base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and white for secondary text and structural elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red, yellow, and green within the ransom-note letters.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the text blocks and clothing against a naturally lit urban environment.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Eclectic mix of sans-serif, slab-serif, and display faces.
letterConstructionRules: Each letter in the masthead is contained within its own rectangular paper-cut block.
Varying background colors for each letter block.
Intentional misalignment and slight rotation of individual letter blocks.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters feature distressed edges simulating physical paper cuts.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Vibrant, chaotic display text paired with clean, high-impact condensed sans-serif for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the bold, condensed feel of the secondary text.
Approximates the masthead style if not custom-made.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle shot of a person in streetwear standing in an urban alleyway with brick buildings and a clear blue sky. Leave the top third of the image clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large masthead using individual multi-colored paper-cut blocks for each letter. Add secondary text in bold condensed sans-serif in the lower corners and on black horizontal bars.

verificationChecks: Does the subject overlap the masthead?
Are the letter blocks in the masthead slightly misaligned?
Are the black graphic bars present?

postGenerationChecks: Check for paper texture on the letter blocks.
Ensure the sky color is vibrant and clear.
Verify the 'tape' bars are solid black.
Confirm the low-angle perspective creates a 'towering' effect.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Low-Angle + Ransom Note Masthead + Black Tape Accents + Condensed Sans-Serif Captions
